$comment: EDE-46 (eDE IDE-look shell, 2026-11-06): THE NUMBERS the shell documents use, in CSS px at 1×, so eDE's documents (apps/ede/ui/*.json) and later the IDE (apps/desktop/crates/ui) agree on one geometry. They come from the IDE (rem = 14 px there; sidebar 272 = the IDE's sidebar, rail 56 = the collapsed icon rail, row 28 = a sidebar row, sectionLabel 24 = a section's label band, panelRadius 12 + panelMargin 10 = the IDE's rounded content card and its margin) and from Mint's panel (taskbar 48, taskbarButton 40 = one grouped-window-list button, appletButton 32 = one applet at the right end, startMenu 760×620 = the three-column menu, previewsTile 184×110 = one hover-preview thumbnail). src/layout.ts reads them; a document that hardcodes a different number is drift.
